description: This source file defines an enumeration 'JavaType' that maps Java class types to internal data types, providing methods for type identification, conversion, and parsing. It is used within the org.apache.fineract.infrastructure.core.service.database package to abstract and handle different Java data types in the project.

classes.name: JavaType
classes.description: Enumeration representing various Java data types, primitives, and objects supporting type checks, conversions, and parsing functionalities.

methods.name: getTypeClass
methods.description: Returns the Class object associated with the JavaType.

methods.name: isPrimitive
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType corresponds to a primitive Java type.

methods.name: isBooleanType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is boolean or Boolean.

methods.name: isByteType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is byte or Byte.

methods.name: isShortType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is short or Short.

methods.name: isIntegerType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is int or Integer.

methods.name: isLongType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is long or Long.

methods.name: isAnyIntegerType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is any integer type, including Byte, Short, Integer, Long, or BigInteger.

methods.name: isFloatType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is float or Float.

methods.name: isDoubleType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is double or Double.

methods.name: isAnyFloatType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is float or double.

methods.name: isDecimalType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is BigDecimal.

methods.name: isObjectNumericType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is a Numeric class.

methods.name: isPrimitiveNumericType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is a primitive numeric type excluding boolean and char.

methods.name: isNumericType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is any numeric type, primitive or object.

methods.name: isStringType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is String.

methods.name: isCharacterType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is char or Character.

methods.name: isDateType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is Date or LocalDate.

methods.name: isTimeType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is Time, LocalTime, or OffsetTime.

methods.name: isDateTimeType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is Timestamp, LocalDateTime, or OffsetDateTime.

methods.name: isAnyDateType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is any date, time, or datetime type.

methods.name: isBinaryType
methods.description: Checks if the JavaType is byte array.

methods.name: getPrimitiveType
methods.description: Returns the primitive JavaType corresponding to this type, if applicable.

methods.name: getObjectType
methods.description: Returns the object wrapper JavaType for this primitive type.

methods.name: forType
methods.description: Resolves a Class<?> to its corresponding JavaType.

methods.name: matchType
methods.description: Checks if a given Class<?> matches this JavaType, considering strictness.

methods.name: isDefault
methods.description: Checks whether an object is the default value for this JavaType.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a String into the JavaType, considering format and locale.
